displayName: OCI-AI-DB-030: AI — RAG Document Integrity Violation
description:
Detects violations of document integrity in RAG systems through unauthorized modifications

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_030", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%rag%' AND "value" > 0
